objective: Expand Parliamo for mid-A1 learners with detailed source-linked practice, guided plans up to 60 minutes, intensive A1 revision and A2 preparation; preserve existing progress and verify the full journey.

acceptance.meaning: Each score is an internal observable acceptance-check result. No human learner satisfaction study, external teacher certification or measured learning outcome is claimed.

rootBrowserVerification.target: Built site-dist static preview, with isolated synthetic learner contexts
checks: all seven budgets produce exact itinerary totals, correct session stages and persistent duration snapshots
changing the time budget caps today's blocks and preserves active or older session steps
all three active programmes combine the right number of grammar blocks and required core mission within 30/45/60-minute budgets
both twelve-question diagnostics preserve wrong first answers, resume after reload, explain corrections and retain results
saved vocabulary persists and an unsuccessful self-rated recall returns tomorrow without repeat credit
large academy backups reach a detailed restore preview; invalid replacements clear stale previews without overwriting work
core and new planning/diagnostic routes fit desktop, 390px and 320px in both languages
no browser runtime errors across the audited journeys

retainedJourneyVerification: All 36 original enrichment scene answers checked in the browser.
Full guided 30-minute session including correction, saved production, vocabulary and badge passed.
Legacy core lesson, failed review, validated backup restore, two-tab updates and EN/IT mobile journeys passed.
Blocked storage, quota exhaustion and corrupt stored progress recovery passed.
rootRepairs: Expanded time controls wrap on phones; the first daily-session action precedes the optional tool directory.
Programme recipes now budget required grammar and one core mission together, including two-unit intensive days and three-unit repair days.
Existing sessions retain original duration and mission. When the budget changes, suggested blocks are capped at the new goal; old sessions without duration retain 30 minutes.
Grammar corrections and same-day retries after feedback remain assisted; a later blind recall can become independent. Dated hint evidence survives reload.
A completed eight-question grammar workshop credits 15 estimated minutes, including reading and personal production.

Backup import boundaries now accept up to 8 MB and were tested with a complete notebook larger than 2 MB. Restore previews include academy counts; selecting an invalid replacement clears a stale preview.
Personal vocabulary retains example sentences when entries overlap between banks and grammar, and exposes further catalogue entries with Show 24 more.
independence: The source agent independently reviewed the grammar author’s content; the grammar author independently exercised root engine/student behavior; the UI author audited its interface and root independently tested the assembled build. Root separately reviewed 22 companion cards. Broader companion drafting and source classification include author self-review.
limits: Page coverage is not 936 unique exercises; repeated physical sources reuse 113 original practice patterns.
Controlled exercises use exact matching with authored alternatives. Free production, companion responses and word-memory ratings are self-assessments.
Both diagnostics test selected grammar and preserve first submitted answers. Unsubmitted diagnostic text is not saved; speaking/listening placement needs separate judgement.
Programme switching restarts its day checklist while preserving learned units and core missions. Study-day duration is an estimate and can span multiple sittings.
Browser checks cover Chromium, representative routes and widths 1440/390/320. No full screen-reader session, native mobile device study or human learner timing trial was performed.
The build reports a large-chunk advisory: approximately 325 kB gzip JavaScript with the full original content catalogue. It builds successfully; mobile-network performance was not benchmarked.
External resources may change or require JavaScript/embedded media consent. Original practice remains available inside the app.

privacyAndRelease.releaseState: Deployed to the existing custom domain and verified over public HTTPS.
